name: Do wall leaks always lead to mold growth?

mainEntity.name: Do wall leaks always lead to mold growth?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wall leaks create the ideal damp environment for mold to thrive, but whether it always leads to mold growth depends on factors like the leak's duration, the humidity levels, and the materials exposed to moisture. Mold can start developing within 24-48 hours of water exposure. Addressing a leak quickly can prevent or minimize mold formation. Our technicians can assess for mold indicators and advise on necessary remediation steps alongside the plumbing repair, helping protect your indoor air quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wall leaks create conditions for mold growth, but it doesn't always occur; rapid repair and drying can prevent or minimize its development.
